_comment: GOLDEN plugin lists captured from the REAL beancount 3.2.0 parser — exactly what fava's `ledger.options.get('plugin', [])` (and thus getLedgerPlugins) reads. Generated via backend-cluster/beancount-ledger/.venv/bin/python: `entries, errors, options_map = beancount.parser.parser.parse_string(SOURCE); [name for name, cfg in options_map.get('plugin', [])]`. parse_string populates options_map['plugin'] at parse time regardless of plugin loadability, so these are the effective parse semantics collectLedgerPlugins must mirror.
